families.hypothesis: Players make short spatial load-balancing decisions and receive immediate physical-looking consequences.
families.copy_boundary: No tower stack, physics-puzzle level, character, layout or scoring system may be copied from a benchmark.

families.hypothesis: Players combine a small vocabulary of signals into increasingly expressive target patterns.
families.copy_boundary: No word-game board, card system, melody, branded symbol set or level layout may be copied.

families.hypothesis: Players allocate scarce capacity across changing demands and can visibly recover from near-failure states.
families.copy_boundary: No merge grid, match-three board, city skin, economy or progression map may be copied.

families.hypothesis: Players read future motion and make a few high-value interception choices per short run.
families.copy_boundary: No runner lane system, projectile skin, level geometry or control layout may be copied.

designs.novelty_contract: Balance a living mobile by choosing attachment points whose leverage changes after every successful hold.
Apply rising-board-tension and clear-chain-payoff principles to an original counterweight mechanic, without blocks or matching.
Compose a target waveform from a changing three-action grammar with visible harmonic consequences.
Apply compact-rule depth and strong system identity to an original signal-composition game, without cards, words or copied symbols.
Route a limited pressure budget among vessels whose safe bands move after each commitment.
Apply first-turn clarity and visible progression to original multi-vessel capacity decisions, without copying a board or economy.
Place a small number of deflectors after reading deterministic trajectories, then watch the whole pattern resolve.
Apply legible spatial state and short-session payoff to original interception planning, without blocks, matching or runner lanes.
